label: Tobacco-size (T206 White Border class)
size_source: PSA CardFacts: 1909-1911 T206 White Border cards measure about 1-7/16" by 2-5/8" — https://www.psacard.com/cardfacts/baseball-cards/1909-1911-t206-white-border/122 (36.51×66.68 mm). Wide tol: PSA says 'about', and period cutting varies. Do not force other tobacco sets onto this guide without their own sourced size.
back_cues: period tobacco advertising backs (brand-specific typography; 16+ T206 back varieties)
grader_notes: SGC is widely used for pre-war tobacco. CGC accepts cards 2-5/8×3-3/4 or smaller, so T206 fits; smaller-than-standard cards may get an inner sleeve. TAG cannot accept cards under 2.5×3.5, including tobacco-size and Topps 206 / Allen & Ginter minis. ARS size caps are TCG mini/regular only. Fragile tobacco may be returned unencapsulated.
